channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Ramon Sessions | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Ramon Sessions from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Ramon Sessions
item.description:
Scott Brooks on the end of Ramon Sessions' current 10-day contract:

“When he doesn't play, it's not a knock on [him]...If he doesn't play tonight we still have to make a decision. We have a day. We don't have to sign him tonight. We'll talk about it after the game.”

Scott Brooks on Ramon Sessions, Mar 4, 2018. Source: Twitter @CandaceDBuckner.

item.title: Scott Perry on Ramon Sessions, Trey Burke
item.description:
NYK GMScott Perry on Ramon Sessions, who was waived to make room for Trey Burke:

“We thank Ramon for being a consummate professional & providing this team with veteran leadership. He is incredibly well respected throughout the organization & we wish him the best moving forward.”

Scott Perry on Ramon Sessions, Trey Burke, Jan 13, 2018. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.

item.title: Mitch Kupchak on Ramon Sessions
item.description:
Mike Bresnahan:Kupchak on Sessions becoming a free agent, declining $4.55-million option:

“My preference is that he would have extended for one more year.”

Mitch Kupchak on Ramon Sessions, Jun 19, 2012. Source: Twitter.
